author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Mike the Hooper, a 2D basketball precision-puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and solve creative puzzles. Find your way through each stage, make tricky shots, and overcome precision platforming challenges along the way. Mike the Hooper is launching on August 14 for PC (Steam).
title: Mike the Hooper - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo trailer for Little Sheep Valley, a Mediterranean farm management game developed by Redknot Games. Players will nurture their very own flock of sheep amongst the calm countryside of their own making. Expand the farm, decorate the buildings, and ensure a safe environment for the sheep. Little Sheep Valley is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Little Sheep Valley - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the console launch trailer for Sizeable, a relaxing and peaceful puzzle/exploration game developed by Business Goose Studios. Shrink and grow your way through small dioramas in search of hidden objects! Sizeable is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Sizeable - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Nekaroo gameplay trailer for Edge of Memories, an anime action-adventure RPG developed by Midgar Studio. Players will explore gorgeous anime-inspired vistas on the back of their Nekaroo, and by interacting with pillars scattered throughout the environment, they will unlock Nekaroo exploration, revealing new paths and areas to discover. Edge of Memories is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Edge of Memories - Official Nekaroo Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the dark and unsettling world of Plobania 47/B, a dystopian narrative-driven game set in the year 2199, where humanity has achieved immortality and paid the ultimate price. In a society overwhelmed by overpopulation and strict government control, you take on the role of Milton Clarke, a registration officer working inside a Mandatory Sleep Hospital. Your job is simple. Review documents, follow the rules, and decide who will be sent to “sleep.” But nothing is ever truly simple in Plobania. Every choice matters. Every mistake has consequences. Plobania 47/B will be available on PC (Steam) in fall 2026.
title: Plobania 47/B - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Match Gameplay for Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters, an upcoming action third-person football (soccer) game developed by Tamsoft Corporation. Players can witness a match of a lifetime with Spain and France taking to the pitch for glory, honor, and victory. Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters is launching on August 28 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters - Official 'Spain vs. France' Match Gameplay Trailer
